note: The pose every enable starts at (E sends these angles; each servo jumps straight to its angle as it is switched on), and where every script ramps back to before it says 'Hold the arm' and disables. arm_jog's home goes here too (a slow J, not the firmware's H). Pose the arm like it by hand before enabling: upper arm vertical, forearm horizontal, claw open. Shoulder 150: the upper arm is vertical there (measured 4 Nov on fresh batteries, Girik). If this file is missing, every joint falls back to 90 with a warning.
